main_text.p: laplam[?] cum Lucifero dixerit, ut multo damno homines ma-staret. Hinc accidit, ut cum sociatione naturæ homo homini junctus, Deus esse deberet, id est beneficus, alter alteri fit Dæmon, & maxime male-ficus. Quivis vel levicula de causa in proximum insurget, neque adeo frivola excogitari poterit, quæ non cuique vel instar damæ timido, moveat bilem. Quisquis alicujus no-tæ videri vult, vel adinstar Gi-gantis, ipsum Jovem, id est virum nullius injuriæ illatæ sibi conscium, ad duellum provo-cabit, addita hac minaci voce: aut tu me si potis es tolle, aut ego te tollam. Cujus mali, si quis investiget occasionem, ea in promptu est. Præcipua est, vindictæ cupido, ira intus sti-mulante; quæ adeo transver-sum rapit animum, ac frænum rationis excutit, ut non am-

page.notes: The first word "laplam" is marked [?]; it is probably "lapsam" (the printer's spelling in the scan is unclear). The catchword "plius" is printed alone at the foot and is therefore kept out of the text. Faint marks at the bottom left and a small scanner or digitiser credit at the bottom right are not printed text and were left out.
